- https://github.com/ubiquity/faucet/blob/0efe857822dde40d63913ceb379babf43f6960e9/src/index.ts#L46
- https://github.com/ubiquity/faucet/blob/0efe857822dde40d63913ceb379babf43f6960e9/src/index.ts#L55

For any address this line returns:
```
[ { users: { wallets: null } } ]
``` 
Hence [here](https://github.com/ubiquity/faucet/pull/4/files#diff-a2a171449d862fe29692ce031981047d7ab755ae7f84c707aef80701b3ea0c80R58) error is shown all the time even if there are no permits for the provided address
Expected behaviour:
1. If there are no permits then allow the faucet to send a payment
2. If there are permits for the provided address then throw an error

The issue remains
Do you have access to pavlovcik's supabase instance?
There is a single permit with id 1 for `beneficiary_id = 119157793` which has wallet address `0x9e4ef4353c928cd3eb473e8f12aecf58c208ef40`
